initialExam.title: GATE Computer Science 2027
initialExam.description: GATE CSE for M.Tech admissions in IITs/NITs and PSU recruitment (ISRO, BHEL, DRDO, etc.) in computer science.
initialExam.eligibility: B.E./B.Tech in CS/IT or MCA or equivalent
initialExam.qualifications: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or MCA
initialExam.syllabus: Engineering Mathematics, Discrete Mathematics, Digital Logic, Computer Organization, Programming & Data Structures, Algorithms, Theory of Computation, Compiler Design, Operating Systems, Databases, Computer Networks.
initialExam.examPattern: 65 questions, 100 marks, 3 hours. MCQ + NAT (Numerical Answer Type). Negative marking for MCQ only.
initialExam.selectionProcess: GATE Score → Apply for M.Tech or PSU recruitment
initialExam.jobRole: M.Tech in IITs/NITs, Scientist in ISRO/DRDO, Engineer in PSUs
initialExam.careerGrowth: Through M.Tech placement or PSU career path.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit GATE website 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: Depends on organization (PSU perks include DA, HRA, Medical, Pension)

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: No age limit for GATE exam
